title: Winged Angel in Mirror
description: A muscular woman with large white feathered wings and purple hair sits on a bed, viewed through an ornate golden mirror frame. She wears a white bikini, has glowing circular markings on her forehead and chest, holds a slice of pizza in one hand, and has her mouth open as if exclaiming, while a red cape flows dramatically beside her against a stormy, lightning-filled sky.
